title: Rendering large lists without virtualization
summary: A framework app renders large lists or tables fully in the DOM.
rationale: Large DOM trees increase layout, paint, memory, and interaction latency.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Use pagination, windowing/virtualization, server-side filtering, and progressive loading.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
